text: No, we can't confirm there were zero thermal detections for the full period. The NASA FIRMS data (VIIRS and MODIS sensors) did not detect any thermal anomalies intersecting the asset during the period of **2026-10-13 to 2026-11-12**. Coverage was continuous except for VIIRS S-NPP, which had a gap from **2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06** due to data unavailability. The other sensors (VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS) maintained full coverage. Since no detections were recorded, we can confirm no thermal activity was observed within the asset's area during this time.
